text:
4277.
An
des Königl. General Major und Gesandten
an Kaiserl Rußl Hofe Herrn von
Schöler Hochwohlgl
zu Petersburg
Hg. 3t mund.
Mit Bezug auf mein Schreiben vom
29ten April d. J. die Verwendung für den
Fürsten Friedrich Ludwig v Hohenlohe
Ingelfingen, bei des Kaisers von Ruß¬
land Majestät zur Bewirkung einige
Ent¬
Entschädigung für die ihm im Kalischen depar¬
tement eingezogenen Güter betreffend so
ich mich veranlaßt, die Ewer Hochwohlge¬
bohren die später eingegangene Nachm[?]¬
daß, da den Fürst von Hohenlohe die
Güter Trąbczyn mit zubehör deterior[irt?]
und mit Schulden belastet hat, die Hypo¬
thekarischen Gläubiger Gefahr laufe
ihre Capitalien zu verlieren, mit¬
Anheimstellen ergebenst mit zutheilen
diesen Umstand, wenn dieselben das
Entschädigungsgesuch des Fürsten unterstü¬
tzen, mitzu Sprache zu bringen.
Zugleich ersuche ich auch Einehml[?].
wohlgebohren ganz ergebenst nur, falls des Kaisers
Majestät dem Fürsten einige Entschä¬
digung zu gewähren geruhen sollte,
Nachricht zu geben, damit die gedachten
Gläubiger zur weitern Verfolgung
ihrer Gerechtsame veranlaßt werden
können.
Berlin d. 22 Juni 1816.
M. d. a. A. 3te S.
Hoffm[ann].
B[alan].
1 Jul[?]

translation.en:
4277.

To the Royal Major General and Envoy at the Imperial Russian Court, Mr von Schöler, Your Right Honourable

at St Petersburg

[uncertain: Hg.] 3rd, fair copy made.

With reference to my letter of 29 April of this year concerning the intercession for the Prince Friedrich Ludwig of Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen with His Majesty the Emperor of Russia, to procure some

names.de: Fürsten Friedrich Ludwig v Hohenlohe Ingelfingen

translation.en:
compensation for the estates confiscated from him in the Kalisz department, I [uncertain: find myself moved] most respectfully to communicate to Your Right Honourable the information [illegible] received later, that, since the Prince of Hohenlohe has let the estates of Trąbczyn with appurtenances [uncertain: deteriorate] and has burdened them with debts, the mortgage creditors run the risk of losing their capital, leaving it to your discretion to bring this circumstance into the discussion, should you support the Prince's claim for compensation. At the same time I also most respectfully request [uncertain: Your] Right Honourable, in case His Majesty the Emperor should deign to grant the Prince some compensation, to send word, so that the said creditors may be moved to pursue their rights further.

Berlin, 22 June 1816.

Ministry of Foreign Affairs, 3rd Section.

Hoffm[ann].

B[alan].

1 Jul[illegible]

text_english:
4277.

To the Royal Major General and Envoy at the Imperial Russian Court, Mr von Schöler, Your Right Honourable

at St Petersburg

[uncertain: Hg.] 3rd, fair copy made.

With reference to my letter of 29 April of this year concerning the intercession for the Prince Friedrich Ludwig of Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen with His Majesty the Emperor of Russia, to procure some

compensation for the estates confiscated from him in the Kalisz department, I [uncertain: find myself moved] most respectfully to communicate to Your Right Honourable the information [illegible] received later, that, since the Prince of Hohenlohe has let the estates of Trąbczyn with appurtenances [uncertain: deteriorate] and has burdened them with debts, the mortgage creditors run the risk of losing their capital, leaving it to your discretion to bring this circumstance into the discussion, should you support the Prince's claim for compensation. At the same time I also most respectfully request [uncertain: Your] Right Honourable, in case His Majesty the Emperor should deign to grant the Prince some compensation, to send word, so that the said creditors may be moved to pursue their rights further.

Berlin, 22 June 1816.

Ministry of Foreign Affairs, 3rd Section.

Hoffm[ann].

B[alan].

1 Jul[illegible]
summary_en: Draft of a letter to Schöler: with reference to the letter of 29 April, the ministry reports that the mortgage creditors are in danger of losing their capital, since the Prince has let Trąbczyn deteriorate and has burdened it with debts; Schöler is asked to raise this. He is to send word if the Emperor grants the Prince compensation, so that the creditors can pursue their claims.
summary_de: Entwurf eines Schreibens an Schöler: Mit Bezug auf das Schreiben vom 29. April teilt das Ministerium mit, dass die hypothekarischen Gläubiger Gefahr laufen, ihre Kapitalien zu verlieren, da der Fürst Trąbczyn deterioriert und mit Schulden belastet hat; Schöler möge dies zur Sprache bringen. Er soll Nachricht geben, falls der Kaiser dem Fürsten eine Entschädigung gewährt, damit die Gläubiger ihre Gerechtsame verfolgen können.

reading.notes: Draft to Schöler at St Petersburg, Berlin, 22 June 1816, from the third section; fair copy 3 July; paraphs of Hoffmann and Balan, 1 July. Following the letter of 29 April on interceding for the Prince, it passes on the later information that, as the Prince ran Trąbczyn down and loaded it with debt, the mortgage creditors risk losing their capital; Schöler may mention this when supporting the request. He is also asked to report if the Emperor grants the Prince any compensation, so that the creditors can pursue their rights.
